questions.prompt: How many speakers can one Gemini multi-speaker TTS request have?

options.explanation: Right. Google says single-request multi-speaker generation supports up to 2 speakers using prebuilt voices.
Google's limit is 2 speakers with prebuilt voices. Custom voices are made one turn at a time.
That is ElevenLabs Text to Dialogue. Gemini's limit is 2 speakers per request.

questions.prompt: ElevenLabs Text to Dialogue: how much text should one request hold?

options.explanation: ElevenLabs says to keep all the turn texts at or below 2,000 characters per request.
Right. ElevenLabs says to keep the total of all turn texts at or below 2,000 characters per request.

options.text: No limit on the text length
options.explanation: ElevenLabs says there is no limit on speakers, but the text should stay at or below 2,000 characters.

questions.prompt: On Gemini, how do you add a listener's short "oh really?" inside the other speaker's turn?

options.text: In angle brackets, as a tag
options.explanation: Angle-bracket tags are for vocal sounds and pauses, like a sigh. Reactions use pipe characters.

options.text: In square brackets, as a tag
options.explanation: Square-bracket audio tags are ElevenLabs' form. Gemini uses pipe characters for these reactions.

options.text: In pipe characters in the text
options.explanation: Right. Google says to wrap listener reactions in pipe characters inside the active speaker's turn.
